thread:
anna (sec): quick thread: prepping private deployment hardening checklist - focus on RBAC tighten, KMS integration posture, netpols, and audit retention. want quick takes.

kai (infra): agree. first ask: default deny egress + explicit KMS proxy only. block IMDS for app pods.

molly (platform): add to that: require keystore-proxy mTLS and wire in a per-tenant endpoint via helm. no direct HSM mounts into pods.

rene (ops): for jumpbox access switch to short-lived certs (1h) issued by internal CA. deprecate long-lived svc tokens.

anna (sec): audit schema for KMS ops: actor, role, key_hash, op, latency_ms, outcome, fallback_used. do NOT log plaintext or request bodies.

sec-bot: sample netpol snippet: apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1; kind: NetworkPolicy; metadata: name: np-private-default-deny; spec: podSelector: {}; policyTypes: [Ingress,Egress]; egress: [{to:[{ipBlock:{cidr:"10.2.12.7/32"}}], ports:[{protocol:TCP,port:8443}]}]

kai (infra): also enforce an admission webhook to reject pods with hostNetwork or hostPath mounts that could reach HSM devices.

molly (platform): RBAC rollout: create new minimal roles, label a preview namespace, run privilege reports for 14 days, then enforce. use query: SELECT actor,resource,event FROM audit_logs WHERE resource LIKE '%keystore%' AND ts>now()-interval '14 days'

rene (ops): can we simulate KMS failures? propose a non-prod canary with a KMS stub that returns controlled 500/timeout. verify audit shows fallback_used=true and alerting fires.

anna (sec): yes. add chaos experiment to playbook: 503s, latency injection, and validate uniform error responses to callers. also patch edge-agent to add exponential backoff + jitter.

kai (infra): vuln note: found header leak on retry path; scrub Authorization header before retries. add unit tests.

molly (platform): logs shipped via mTLS to collector; redact fields matching (?i)(pass|key|secret). retention: 90 days cluster, 1 year central for enterprise; CMK option for private installs.

anna (sec): final: exceptions for direct HSM access require written risk acceptance + SOC signoff + quarterly attestations.

kai (infra): i'll open PRs: netpol template + admission webhook. molly will draft RBAC plan, rene will provision canary. anna will update playbook and audit schema.

anna (sec): thanks all, tag me on PRs. schedule 20m sync after PRs land. :white_check_mark:
